author: JohnFkennidy
quote: I rarely write reviews but seeing all 10/10s critic scores despite the game's issues as a consumer made me speakup. Game is beautiful but as a true GTA title, it is a massive step backward losts its identity, thats why i can't support it. I'd give it a 6/10 the 0 rating is just for the dishonest critics

author: JohnFkennidy
quote: Visually impressive and technically polished, but feels like a sanitized HR-approved amusement park compared to older entries, it lost its GTA identity and became Sims with guns. Will probably be the first GOTY flop.
